title: QB White Triangle FAQ
html:
Q: Help! I had chosen wrong region for BamCo account! What do I do?

A: IF you have registered through Twitter, you can circumvent this issue by logging out from BamCo, deactivating permissions for BamCo from Twitter, re-connecting it to BamCo again and choosing Japan as region. You will not lose your progress and will be able to play the game normally.

Q: Do you recommend anyone? Who's the best one? Will I miss out any girls?

A: I personally don't have any recommendation, just pick your Waifu! Every girl has their own pros and cons, more on that later. Thankfully you won't miss out anyone.

Q: Is there permanent death in the game?

A: No. You won't lose anyone regardless how you lose any mission (due to PKD a girl and/or team) or arena showdown.

Q: Wiki mentions Enza account has some benefits. What are they?

A: You can get free Enza points and redeem them for premium items. The guide for it will be at the end of this section.

Q: Do you recommend any special premium item? A: Yes. Buying the following item will give you additional gems for 1 month.
